title: Inference Stack
excerpt: Everything you need to own your inference. Deploy with one command.
content_html:
Everything you need to own your inference.
Deploy with one command.

For one machine. Requires Docker with Compose, curl, and OpenSSL. Setup details

curl -fsSL https://github.com/BerriAI/inference-stack/releases/download/v0.3.1/install.sh | bash -s -- docker

Open localhost:8080 and sign in as admin with the generated password. Open Deployments, choose a model, and deploy it. When it is ready, choose Try in LiteLLM to send a prompt.

Real models need NVIDIA GPUs. No GPU? Enable simulation in the model’s Settings for canned responses.

vLLM

Search Hugging Face, check GPU requirements, and deploy from the launcher. vLLM runs the model on your GPUs.

vLLM docs

LiteLLM

Manage models and send requests through one API, or try them in Chat.

LiteLLM docs

llm-d

Selects a vLLM replica for each request using cache and queue data. Routing works by default; adjust the weights when you need to.

llm-d docs

Grafana

See model health, request traffic, and response times in the included dashboards. Metrics come from Prometheus.

Grafana docs
